statements.english: So you talked to her ? Did she sound mad ?
statements.chinese: 所以你和她谈过了？她听起来生气吗？

Did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: No . But she likes me
statements.chinese: 不。但她喜欢我。

likes.definition: like（第三人称单数）: 喜欢

statements.english: You abandoned her on a plane to Greece
statements.chinese: 你把她遗弃在飞往希腊的飞机上。

statements.english: Okay , I did not " abandon " Rachel . Okay ?
statements.chinese: 好吧，我并没有“抛弃”Rachel，行了吧？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句或否定句

statements.english: Emily showed up at the airport
statements.chinese: Emily出现在机场。

statements.english: I had to go after her . I mean I did what I had to do
statements.chinese: 我必须去追她。我是说，我只是做了我该做的事。

statements.english: She's my wife . Rachel is my wife
statements.chinese: 她是我的妻子。Rachel是我的妻子。

statements.english: Emily !
statements.chinese: Emily!

statements.english: Emily is my wife
statements.chinese: Emily是我的妻子。

statements.english: Man , what is that ?
statements.chinese: 老兄，那是什么？

statements.english: So you still haven't heard from Emily ?
statements.chinese: 所以你还是没收到Emily的消息吗？

statements.english: No , not since I lost her at the airport
statements.chinese: 不，自从我在机场和她走散后就再也没见过。

statements.english: I can't believe she can outrun you
statements.chinese: 真不敢相信她能跑得比你快。

statements.english: Hey ! She's fast , okay ?
statements.chinese: 喂！她速度很快的，好吗？

statements.english: You think you can beat me ?
statements.chinese: 你以为你能打败我？

statements.english: Let's go ! Outside !
statements.chinese: 出发吧！到外面去！

statements.english: - Hi ! - Oh , my God , Rachel !
statements.chinese: 嗨！ - 天啊，Rachel！

statements.english: Rach , Rach , I am so sorry . I am so , so sorry
statements.chinese: Rach，Rach，真的很抱歉。我实在太对不起了。

statements.english: Ross , come on . You just did what you had to do
statements.chinese: Ross，别这样。你只是做了你该做的事。

statements.english: Hi , Pheebs
statements.chinese: 嗨，Pheebs。

statements.english: That's it ? You're not mad ? It must've been terrible
statements.chinese: 就这样？你没生气吗？那一定糟透了。

statements.english: Terrible ? Hell , I was in Greece !
statements.chinese: 糟糕？见鬼，我当时可是在希腊！

statements.english: There was a nice hotel , nice beach , met the nice people
statements.chinese: 有一家不错的酒店，美丽的海滩，还遇到了友善的人们。

statements.english: It's not too shabby for Rachel
statements.chinese: 对Rachel来说这不算太寒酸。

statements.english: So , what , that's it ?
statements.chinese: 所以呢，就这样完了？

statements.english: Oh yeah
statements.chinese: 哦耶。

statements.english: We're cool . Totally cool
statements.chinese: 我们很好。完全没问题。

statements.english: Thanks , Rach . You're the best
statements.chinese: 谢了，Rach。你最棒了。

statements.english: Oh , no . You're the best
statements.chinese: 噢，不。你是最棒的。

statements.english: Oh , I got to go to the flower store
statements.chinese: 哦，我得去趟花店。

statements.english: Check it out , no one will tell me where Emily is ..
statements.chinese: 快看啊，没人愿意告诉我Emily在哪里...

statements.english: So I'm gonna send 72 long-stemmed , red roses to her parents' house
statements.chinese: 所以我打算往她父母家送72支长茎红玫瑰。

statements.english: One for each day that I've known and loved her
statements.chinese: 每一天都有一份，代表我认识并爱着她的每一天。

that.definition: 关系代词（引导定语从句）

statements.english: That ought get her talking to me again
statements.chinese: 这下她该愿意跟我说话了吧。

statements.english: Ross , when you make out the card
statements.chinese: Ross，当你填写卡片时，

statements.english: be sure to make it out to " Emily ."
statements.chinese: 务必将其开给"Emily"。

statements.english: That's great , it's so good that you had such a good time in Greece
statements.chinese: 太好了，真高兴你在希腊玩得这么开心。

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: I didn't have a good time in Greece !
statements.chinese: 我在希腊过得不开心！

statements.english: Ross abandoned me ! Okay ?
statements.chinese: Ross抛弃了我！行吗？

statements.english: I couldn't get a plane out
statements.chinese: 我无法搭乘飞机离开。

statements.english: I had to stay in their honeymoon suite !
statements.chinese: 我不得不入住他们的蜜月套房！

had.definition: have（过去式）: 构成过去完成时

statements.english: With people coming up to me all the time going
statements.chinese: 人们总是凑过来对我说，

statements.english: " Mrs. Geller ! Why are you cry ?"
statements.chinese: Geller太太！您为什么在哭？

statements.english: I mean , it was so humiliating !
statements.chinese: 我是说，这简直太丢人了！

statements.english: I felt like such an idiot !
statements.chinese: 我感觉自己像个白痴！

statements.english: I mean it's all my fault . You know why ?
statements.chinese: 我是说这都是我的错。你知道为什么吗？

statements.english: Because I make very bad decisions
statements.chinese: 因为我总是做出非常糟糕的决定。

statements.english: - Oh , that's not true . - Yes it is
statements.chinese: - 哦，那不是真的。 - 不，就是真的。

statements.english: It is true . I went after Ross in stupid London !
statements.chinese: 没错。我就是在愚蠢的London追着Ross跑！

statements.english: London is stupid ! Stupid !
statements.chinese: London真是蠢透了！蠢透了！

statements.english: Phoebe , you were right . I should've never gone to London
statements.chinese: Phoebe，你说得对。我根本就不该去伦敦。

statements.english: From now on , you make all my decisions for me
statements.chinese: 从现在起，我的一切决定都由你来做。
